fields.title: The Alchemist
fields.author: Paulo Coelho
fields.description: A story about following dreams, discovering oneself, and finding the meaning of life.

fields.title: Atomic Habits
fields.author: James Clear
fields.description: A practical book about building good habits and improving daily routines.

fields.title: Ikigai
fields.author: Hector Garcia and Francesc Miralles
fields.description: Ikigai explores the Japanese concept of finding purpose and meaning in everyday life. The book discusses habits, relationships, lifestyle, and ideas that can help people live a more meaningful and balanced life.

fields.title: Rich Dad Poor Dad
fields.author: Robert T. Kiyosaki
fields.description: Rich Dad Poor Dad explains basic ideas about money, financial education, assets, liabilities, and building long-term financial independence. The book presents different approaches to managing and thinking about money.

fields.title: The Psychology of Money
fields.author: Morgan Housel
fields.description: The Psychology of Money explores how emotions, behavior, personal experiences, and habits influence financial decisions. It presents practical ideas about saving, investing, wealth, and long-term financial thinking.

fields.title: The Kite Runner
fields.author: Khaled Hosseini
fields.description: The Kite Runner is a story about friendship, family, guilt, and redemption. It follows the relationship between two childhood friends and explores how choices from the past can affect life in the future.

fields.title: Think and Grow Rich
fields.author: Napoleon Hill
fields.description: Think and Grow Rich discusses principles of success, goal setting, persistence, and personal achievement. The book focuses on developing a determined mindset and turning goals into practical action.

fields.title: The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People
fields.author: Stephen R. Covey
fields.description: The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People presents principles for personal effectiveness, responsibility, relationships, and continuous improvement. It focuses on developing habits that support meaningful personal and professional growth.

fields.title: To Kill a Mockingbird
fields.author: Harper Lee
fields.description: To Kill a Mockingbird is a classic novel that explores justice, morality, compassion, and prejudice through the experiences of a young girl growing up in the American South.

fields.title: Build, Don't Talk
fields.author: Raj Shamani
fields.description: Build, Don't Talk is a practical guide about personal growth, communication, networking, finance, and building useful real-world skills. The book focuses on taking action, developing valuable skills, and learning things that are often not taught in school.
